dataset: All890 paired and60 challenging official UIEB inputs; retain every file and all duplicates, without outcome-based exclusions.

preprocessing.geometry: Aspect-preserving downsample only to long edge <=256; round each scaled dimension via Python round; no crop; no upsampling.
preprocessing.resize: Pillow RGB uint8 Resampling.LANCZOS, identical target size/interpolation for raw and reference; then float32/255
preprocessing.padding: All networks: external right/bottom reflect padding to next multiple of16; remove padding before metrics. NAFNet then requires no extra internal zero padding.
preprocessing.network_input: [N,8,3,H,W], RGB, float32 [0,1], frame-major flatten to24 channels internally
preprocessing.slots: eight exact copies of one still; preserve single slot4 repeat or mean wrapper; no artificial diversity
preprocessing.normalization: division by255 only; no gamma conversion, channel standardization, white balance or fitted calibration; ignore EXIF orientation/profile transforms
preprocessing.output: save unclipped FP32 numpy; clip to[0,1] for metrics; PNG = np.rint(255*clip).astype(uint8)
preprocessing.baseline: on resized unpadded RGB float32, per channel np.percentile([1,99],method=linear) over all pixels; zero range ->0; clip[0,1]

metrics.PSNR: -10 log10 mean(float64(pred)-float64(ref))^2; data_range1, all RGB values; inf for exact match
metrics.SSIM: skimage.metrics.structural_similarity, channel_axis=2, data_range=1, win_size=7, gaussian_weights=False, use_sample_covariance=True, K1=.01,K2=.03; full unpadded RGB, standard3-pixel boundary exclusion internal
metrics.MAE: mean absolute error over all RGB scalar values in float64
metrics.aggregation: equal weight per image; arithmetic means and sample SD, n=20; no pooled-pixel PSNR; paired differences versus raw and stretch

preprocessing.numeric: FP32 CUDA, two CPU threads, no autocast; TF32off, cuDNN deterministic, benchmarkFalse; seed1337, batch1; one resident model
preprocessing.training_geometry: 256x256 fixed training inputs; this pilot uses smaller rectangular fields plus minimal padding; native resolution is separate feasibility work
preprocessing.failure_policy: Keep selected inputs and explicit failed record; no replacement, no model-specific preprocessing fallback.

display_selection: Identifier-based subset beginning/middle/end plus native-area/aspect extremes; separately marked previously exposed pilot illustrations. No model-performance selection.
failures: Keep explicit failed image-method records; no replacements or individual preprocessing fallback.
pilot_separation: Original pad8 pilot remains unchanged; every network is inferred afresh using common pad16.
